bluejetty:00014159:ios.name: Goodreads: Book Tracker & More
bluejetty:00014159:ios.summary: Goodreads is the free book tracker and reading community for everyone who loves books. With more than 150 million members, it is the world's largest community of readers. Keep track of everything you've read, discover your next favorite boo
bluejetty:00014159:ios.description:
Goodreads is the free book tracker and reading community for everyone who loves books. With more than 150 million members, it is the world's largest community of readers. Keep track of everything you've read, discover your next favorite book, save it to your Want to Read shelf, and update your reading progress as you go. Then share your shelves and progress with friends who love books as much as you do. Rate and review books, read honest reviews from other readers, join book club groups, and talk about the stories you can't stop thinking about.
Behind all those conversations is a book tracker that makes staying organized easy. Add a book in seconds by scanning the cover or searching by title, author, or ISBN. Add it to your Want to Read, Currently Reading, Read, or Did Not Finish (DNF) shelf, or create your own book lists for beach reads, favorite series, or the books your friends keep recommending. Want to read more this year? Set a personal goal with the Reading Challenge, adjust it anytime, and follow along as friends work toward theirs. Take on seasonal challenges and watch your reading tracker fill up as you go. When the year ends, Year in Books recaps every page you read.
Reading is better with company. Follow friends to discover what they're reading and find more books to read, rate the books you finish, and check reviews from millions of readers before you pick your next one. Join a book club through Goodreads groups to read along and share your thoughts, or recommend a favorite to a friend who needs it. You can even vote for your favorite books of the year in the Goodreads Choice Awards.
GOODREADS FEATURES
FREE BOOK TRACKER, LOG & LISTS
• Rate books with half, quarter or whole stars, share your review, and like or comment on reviews from other readers.
• Book Scanner: Scan a cover or search by title, author, or ISBN to add any book to your book tracker in seconds.
• Reading tracker: Organize your Read, Currently Reading, and Want to Read shelves, plus custom book lists for any genre or mood.
• Did Not Finish shelf: Keep track of the books you set aside, so your reading history tells the whole story.
• Update your progress by page or percentage and keep a book log of every title you finish.
• Set a yearly reading goal with the Reading Challenge and earn achievements in seasonal challenges.
• Look back on your Year in Books, a recap of every book from your reading tracker.
DISCOVER NEW BOOKS TO READ
• Get personalized recommendations based on the books you've read and loved. With millions of ratings and reviews, discover what's trending this week in your favorite genres, from romance to historical fiction, and find new books to read.
• Get ahead of the next big release with our Most Anticipated Books lists, based on what readers are adding to their Want to Read shelves, plus author interviews and featured lists.
• Use the Book Scanner at the bookstore or library to pull up ratings and reviews instantly and decide if it's your next read.
READING COMMUNITY & BOOK CLUBS
• Connect with a reading community of more than 150 million members.
• Join book club groups to start discussions and meet readers who share your taste.
• Keep up with what friends add to their shelves and how their reading goals are going.
• Recommend books to friends and vote for your favorites in the Goodreads Choice Awards.
Whether you're logging your latest read or discovering your next obsession, Goodreads is the free reading tracker made for readers like you. Join the community and start building your shelves today.
By using this app, you agree to Goodreads’s Terms of Use (https://www.goodreads.com/about/terms) and Privacy Policy (https://www.goodreads.com/about/privacy).

bluejetty:00014357:ios.name: KB Klíč
bluejetty:00014357:ios.summary:
The KB Klíč app verifies your identity and safely logs you into MojeBanka online banking and Komerční banka's other online apps. You don't have to enter a texted code and you also authorise payments through the app.
You need the following
bluejetty:00014357:ios.description:
The KB Klíč app verifies your identity and safely logs you into MojeBanka online banking and Komerční banka's other online apps. You don't have to enter a texted code and you also authorise payments through the app.
You need the following for KB Klíč activation:
- KB ID, which you will find in the Electronic Signature Agreement. You can also use your username/email
- An activation code that you will receive at a KB branch or when you log into mujprofil.kb.cz otherwise than via KB Klíč
The activation guide is available at https://www.kb.cz/en/faq-and-support/how-to-sign-in
Set the PIN on the occasion of activation. You can set up your fingerprint if your phone supports them. Komerční banka will never see your fingerprints; they are retained in a secure repository in the phone.
If your phone is connected to the internet the request to confirm the activation will be received automatically in your phone. Check and confirm the request. If offline, select 'The device is not connected to the internet' option in your computer. Using the KB Klíč app, scan the pictorial code from the computer's screen. Then confirm the code by the PIN or fingerprint. Finally, type the generated code in your computer.
Please note: If you enter an incorrect PIN five times KB Klíč blocks access. You will then activate the apps using an activation code that you will receive in an ATM, at a KB branch or after logging into mujprofil.kb.cz otherwise than via KB Klíč.
KB Klíč will not work for you if you have reinstalled software on your phone and your platform (root) is therefore not protected. All of this for the sake of security.

bluejetty:00015832:ios.name: Uffizi Gallery
bluejetty:00015832:ios.summary:
Locate, listen, explore and enjoy the artworks of the Uffizi Gallery.
Forget traditional audio guides. All you need is in your pocket. 
Essential and immediate, the app that will guide you during your visit without diverting your attention
bluejetty:00015832:ios.description:
Locate, listen, explore and enjoy the artworks of the Uffizi Gallery.
Forget traditional audio guides. All you need is in your pocket. 
Essential and immediate, the app that will guide you during your visit without diverting your attention from the artworks.
40 of the most beautiful and important artworks of the Uffizi Gallery, description and audios.
Easy and smart access to info
Discover artworks through the exploration page and find them grouped by position or artist.
Use textual research to find them typing the title or artist name.
Add artworks to your favorite collection to find them quickly and to share them with your friends.
Image, Audio, Details
Wear headphones or bring your phone to your ear and let yourself be guided by narrations.
Look at the images or discover the details of the artworks to better appreciate them.
Image recognition
Recognize artworks by framing them with your camera. 
If they are in the app, you'll be able to immediately access the corresponding information.
Interactive maps
Check the position of artworks to better move around and locate yourself.
Find rooms and artworks and explore each detail.
Accessible
Art belongs to everyone. Accessibility is one of the issues we most cherish. 
This app can be used the same way by sighted people and people with visual impairments: nobody shall be left behind!
...and now...download it and simply enjoy your tour...
PS: if you have dubts or suggestions contact us at support@itcares.it

bluejetty:00016935:ios.summary:

*Professional vocalists can see if audition cuts for the most recent National Tours and Broadway Shows have been recorded.
*Singing teachers who subscribe c
bluejetty:00016935:ios.description:
*Students who subscribe can access the entire library for auditions and rehearsals.
*Professional vocalists can see if audition cuts for the most recent National Tours and Broadway Shows have been recorded.
*Singing teachers who subscribe can stream the entire song before they decide if it's a good fit for their students and download it as an Mp3 on their computer hard drive.
*Schools and theaters can find entire shows for rehearsals and/or performances.
Features:
•Purchase and download individual tracks.
•Change key and tempo.
•Browse by category or search individual titles or shows.
•Create multiple playlists.
•Add pins to mark the spots you rehearse most, see each pin's time at a glance, and jump between them with a location slider.
•Hear a 30-second preview of any song before you sign in or subscribe, and the full song once you do.
•We offer free exchanges if you want a new version of the song you've purchased.
•There are melody versions to help you learn your song and piano versions when you don't need the guide melody any longer.
•When you connect the app to a Bluetooth speaker in "airplane mode" it works well for auditions and self taping submissions.
•Larger text sizes are supported throughout the app.
•All purchases made from PianoTrax.com will automatically be available in the app. All purchases from the app will instantly be available in your account on the website.
•If you can't find the song you need already on the app we can record it for you.
Subscription features:
- Stream the entire library.
- Redeem free Mp3s on your computer.
- Monthly subscriptions include 3 Free Mp3s per month.
- Annual subscriptions allow the user to redeem 36 Mp3s anytime.
- If you need additional Mp3s, you will receive an automatic discount on checkout.
- Any Mp3s purchased while subscribed remain in your account even if you discontinue your subscription.
USD $9.99 per month or
USD $99.99 per year (a $20 savings).
7 Day free trial on all subscriptions.
*Payment will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase.
*Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
*Your account will be charged for the renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period.
*Subscriptions may be managed and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to Account Settings after purchase.
*If within the 7 day free trial period you cancel for any reason you will not be charged. If you continue, your paid subscription begins at the end of your free trial.
To view Privacy Policy go to:
https://www.pianotrax.com/privacy-policy
To see Terms and Conditions go to:
https://www.pianotrax.com/terms-and-conditions

bluejetty:00015626:ios.description:
Chosen by over 95 million students worldwide, QANDA helps you learn smarter and more enjoyably. Experience the new QANDA today—studying becomes easier and even fun!
• Stuck on a question? Just ask.For the last 10 years, QANDA has answered billions of student questions, providing the most accurate step-by-step explanations.
Now, in addition to taking a photo of your question, you can chat with QANDA AI to solve problems interactively. 
Try asking:“Make a similar question using this concept.”
You’ll instantly get a concept quiz. QANDA not only gives you the answer—it also generates step-by-step solutions, concept quizzes, similar problems, and even an incorrect-answer notebook.
• All the study tools you needQANDA includes everything you need while studying—from past exam questions and quizzes to a formula calculator and QANDA Notes.

apple-itunes:980887055.description:
** As FEATURED by Apple in “New Apps We Love” **
This is a different kind of notes app. Simpler. Smarter. Better.
You can type #hashtags into your notes to organize them.
#hashtags link all the tagged notes together—tap on any to see them all.
We'll find any phone numbers, email addresses, or links in your notes, too, and you can tap on those to call, email, or go to the web.

We hope this app helps you capture the thoughts that are important to you—thank you so much for giving it a try.
